description: This source file defines the 'CausalClock' class, providing functionality for generating and merging logical timestamp clocks within the Orleans.Transactions namespace, utilizing external clock sources.

classes.name: CausalClock
classes.description: A class implementing a causal clock for transaction ordering, with methods to get current logical time and merge timestamps.

methods.name: CausalClock
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CausalClock with an external IClock instance, throwing if null.

methods.name: UtcNow
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp considering causal ordering, using internal locking for thread safety.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges an external timestamp into the clock, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: MergeUtcNow
methods.description: Merges the current UTC time with an external timestamp, advancing logical clock as needed.
